desc.es: A dos años de un revamp radical, la marca usaba menos de la mitad de su manual. Hice un benchmark, audité qué quedaba y qué salía, rehice paleta, tipografías e iconografía, y armé en Figma un brandbook de 130+ páginas con índice interactivo: estrategia, tono, identidad visual, dirección de arte y prompts para IA.
desc.en: Two years after a radical rebrand, the company used less than half of its brand manual. I ran a benchmark, audited what stayed and what went, rebuilt the palette, typography and iconography, and built a 130+ page Figma brandbook with an interactive index: strategy, tone, visual identity, art direction and AI prompts.

desc.es: Rediseñé el personaje de marca de 3D a 2D para modernizarlo sin perder reconocimiento. Hoy es parte del sistema, con sus propias expresiones y casos de uso documentados en el Brandbook 2026.
desc.en: I redesigned the brand character from 3D to 2D to modernize it without losing recognition. It's now part of the system, with its own expressions and use cases documented in the 2026 Brandbook.

desc.en: I created the campaign logo and key visual as a system that adapts to social, banners, email and ads. Each campaign like this meant 45 to 50 assets per country.

desc.es: Diseñé y programé con Claude Code una landing sobre HubSpot, con repositorio en GitHub, que supera los límites de su editor sin perder su analítica. Con A/B testing (AB Tasty + Heap) llegó a 34% de conversión a cotización en desktop y 32% en mobile, y hoy es la plantilla de 21 landings de producto.
desc.en: I designed and coded a HubSpot landing page with Claude Code and a GitHub repo, getting past the visual editor's limits while keeping its analytics. A/B testing (AB Tasty + Heap) took it to 34% desktop and 32% mobile quote conversion, and it's now the template for 21 product landings.

desc.en: The brand's homepage rebuilt with Claude Code and web design skills: new interactions and animations to improve the experience, aligned with the brand's visual system.

desc.en: I migrated the 120+ articles of El Comparador, Compara Chile's blog, from HubSpot and automated publishing with Claude Code, Notion and GitHub. Publishing work from 6 to 8 writers took me 3 to 4 hours a day; now it's one message and one enter: 20 hours freed every week.
